title: Vincenzo I Gonzaga, Duke of Mantua, to Louis de Gonzague, duc de Nevers, 17 Sept 1590 (BnF fr. 3979 ff. 92-93, DECODE R4176)

steps.what: Tomokiyo nevers.htm and the DECODE record checked for a decipherment of R4176.
DECODE R4176 images P1-P14 downloaded with the session cookie.
Tomokiyo's Nevers cipher no. 35, described as used by the Duke of Mantua in 1590, traced to BnF fr. 3995 f. 64 'Per Cavare 1590' (Gallica btv1b525085665 canvas 131) and read.
Unseparated two-digit figures transcribed from the images: f. 92r in the main session, ff. 92v and 93r by two subagents.
Key applied unchanged; Italian reads at once on f. 92r (la morte del Papa sia stata procurata con veleno da Spagnoli).
Beam decoder with the it-cinquecento LM resolving 3/9 and 0/8 look-alikes, then 7/8 added; f. 93r reads through.
Sign and title values (che, per, et, S. M.ta, Legato, Monsignor ...) read from the key sheet and substituted.
Retry pass: a subagent re-read the doubtful lines at 3x; about 829 of 945 tokens now read (88%); garbled stretches on f. 92r and f. 93r and three signs absent from the key remain.

Blind re-transcription at 4x of every unread stretch by a subagent that had not seen ct_*.txt (blind_92r.md, blind_93r.md), compared with the old digits and decoded with beam.py/beam2.py: read contro cotesto Regno di Francia, buoni Italiani, anichilata, si vede, far riverenza, in quello; sottoporsi confirmed as written; +56 tokens; 92r l5 tail, l8 middle, 93r l4/l5/l8 and 92v stretch still do not read.

Second independent image: BnF microfilm on Gallica (btv1b9060544v, canvases 160-162) used to re-read every unread stretch. f. 93r l4 q-like sign = key's non, ● = che, 'si come non ho mancato in quello che'; l5 14 35 31 38 'hora'. 92r l5 tail, 92r l8 middle, 92v 'la mondeza a me' and 93r l8 code group match the DECODE digits and stay unread. Measured 878 of 923 tokens (95.1%).

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo's Nevers cipher no. 35, which he lists as used by the Duke of Mantua in 1590, was traced to its key sheet in BnF fr. 3995 f. 64 and applied unchanged to R4176, with an Italian LM beam only to resolve look-alike digits.
outcome.fraction_read_source: gonzaga1590/reading.md token table: 878 of 923 cipher tokens (digits/2 + signs counted from ct_*.txt; unread stretches counted in pairs; nulls as read)
outcome.notes: Archive key applied unchanged; Mantua on the rumoured poisoning of Sixtus V by the Spaniards and his devotion to the French crown.
